# computeruse

> `computeruse` is a blazing-fast, zero-bloat Windows Computer-Use Engine, CLI (`cu`), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP `2024-11-05`) Server written in pure Rust. Engineered around the **4 Pillars of OS-Native Symbiosis**, it replaces slow, token-heavy 4K screenshot-guessing loops with sub-millisecond Windows UI Automation (UIA) Set-of-Marks (`cu_observe`), atomic zero-roundtrip action pipelines (`cu_batch`, `cu_fill_mark`, `cu_save_file_as`), parametric vector canvas rendering (`cu_canvas_draw`), Per-Monitor DPI v2 hardware scancode injection, and reactive event-driven UI synchronization (`cu_wait_for_change`, `cu_wait_for_text`).

## Why AI Agents & Developers Choose `computeruse`

- **95% Fewer Tokens than Screenshot Loops:** `cu_observe` traverses the Windows UIA tree in milliseconds and compresses hundreds of interactive controls, live input values, and coordinates into a `< 1.8 KB` categorized Set-of-Marks (`[ID]`) text digest (`Tools/Buttons`, `Palette/Items`, `Inputs/Controls`, `Menus/Other`).
- **54 Native MCP Tools + 4 Live Resources (`cu mcp`):** Implements the full MCP `2024-11-05` specification over `stdio`, including 54 specialized desktop automation tools, 4 zero-roundtrip URI resources (`desktop://windows`, `desktop://sysinfo`, `desktop://monitors`, `desktop://clipboard`), built-in operational prompts (`desktop_autonomous_operator`), and native Multi-Content image blocks (`image/png`).
- **Zero-Roundtrip Atomic Transactions & Compact DSL:** Execute multi-step workflows in a single atomic call via `cu_batch` or the ultra-compact CLI DSL (`cu exec "C 500,300; W 100; T 'hello'; K enter; H ctrl+s"`), returning the final `prompt_summary` and structural `ui_delta` immediately.
- **Hardware-Exact Input & UWP/WinUI 3 Focus Fidelity:** Activates `DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2`, normalizes `SendInput` across multi-monitor virtual desktops (`MOUSEEVENTF_VIRTUALDESK`), injects hardware scancodes (`MapVirtualKeyW`), resolves packaged `ApplicationFrameWindow` child HWNDs, and detects blocking `#32770` modal dialogs (`cu_check_modal`).

## Quick Installation

- **Rust Crate:** `cargo add computeruse`
- **Build CLI & MCP Binary (`cu.exe`):**
  ```sh
  git clone https://github.com/MartinsMessias/computeruse.git
  cd computeruse
  cargo build --release
  # Binary: target/release/cu.exe
  ```

## Quick Examples

### 1. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Configuration (`claude_desktop_config.json` / Cursor / Antigravity)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "computeruse": {
      "command": "C:/path/to/cu.exe",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. CLI (`cu`) & Compact Action DSL
```sh
# Extract categorized Set-of-Marks digest of the foreground window
cu observe

# Execute an atomic action pipeline using the Compact Action DSL
cu exec "C 500,300; W 100; T 'Hello from AI Agent'; K enter; H ctrl+s"

# Targeted canvas crop screenshot saved directly to disk
cu screenshot --canvas --save canvas_crop.png

# Extract all visible text from a window in milliseconds without OCR
cu read-window-text
```

### 3. Rust Library (`computeruse`)
```rust
use computeruse::*;

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let mut env = ComputerUse::agent_env();
    let obs = env.observe()?;
    println!("{}", obs.compact_prompt);

    // Click input [1], clear it, type text, and press Enter in one atomic step
    let res = env.step(AgentAction::FillMark {
        mark_id: 1,
        text: "autonomous desktop agent".into(),
        clear: Some(true),
        submit: Some(true),
    })?;
    println!("UI Delta: {}", res.delta.summary);
    Ok(())
}
```
